round: DF5.3 N6 — produce and walk a real merged factory PR
verdict: DEMO BROKEN — 8/10 hops resolve; 2 product defects block a COMPLETE chain

tree.note: PR #258 was OPEN, not merged, contrary to the handoff. The audit-chain code exists only on this branch, so the round ran from it.

authorizationOrdering.note: AC7 strict preflight satisfied: completedAt < decidedAt < prCreatedAt.

spend.note: box-hours priced from the operator-authored .sandbox/cost-config.json boxHourRateMicroUsd (3600000 µ$/h); it is a local rate, not a vendor invoice.

secondWalk.note: First-observation digest rows for pr-run / run-reverify / run-approval are stable across walks; no spurious evidence-mismatch.

findings.title: The walker's bundle digest is computed through a latin1->utf8 round-trip, so it can never match the emitted file hash for a binary bundle
findings.analysis: harvest.ts emits detail.sha256 = sha256File(hostBundle), the true file hash. The walker re-derives it as sha256Hex(bytes.toString("latin1")); Bun's CryptoHasher.update(string) encodes as UTF-8, so every byte >= 0x80 expands to two bytes. A git bundle is binary, so the two values disagree for every real bundle and the hop reports evidence-mismatch unconditionally.
findings.fix: Hash the Buffer directly rather than a latin1 string round-trip.

findings.title: The dispatch->run engine invocation is structurally bare, so sessions.repo_slug/issue_id are NULL on every dispatched run, which hop 2 fails closed on for PR-rooted walks
findings.site: scripts/pipeline-run.ts deriveInBoxArgv ("Correlation flags are deliberately absent: the in-box invocation is bare.") vs src/audit/chain.ts hop run-issue

evidence.walkerDiagnostic: admission required the issue ref, so NULL correlation on a PR-bearing run cannot arise — fail closed

findings.analysis: deriveInBoxArgv passes --run-id and deliberately omits --repo-slug/--issue; RUN_ID_CONFLICT in the same file refuses --repo-slug alongside --run-id, so the correlated shape is unreachable from fleet dispatch/run. The correlation the walker requires therefore never reaches the in-box tracer, even though dispatch admitted on (repoSlug, issueId) and the cost ledger records both. The walker's not-applicable escape (BARE_RUN_NULL_CORRELATION_REASON) fires only for the bare run-id ref form, never for a PR URL.
findings.fix: Either propagate the correlation into the in-box sessions row (dispatch already has it in the witness), or let hop 2 accept the dispatched-run shape the way it accepts the bare-run one. This is a design decision, not a one-liner.

findings.title: Run records store the lowercased canonical repoSlug but .factory allowlists are looked up by exact match, so correctly-cased operator config fails after teardown

evidence.observedFailure: reverify verdict=error code=no-host-plan, raised after the box was destroyed and the record closed

findings.analysis: canonicalRepoSlug lowercases the slug into the run record, while resolveHostPlan and resolveRepoEntry both do Object.hasOwn(index.repos, repoSlug). An operator who registers the repository under GitHub's actual casing gets a green dispatch, a green run, a successful harvest and teardown, and then a no-host-plan veto with the box already gone. Worked around this round by adding both spellings to .factory/{pipeline,repos}.json.
findings.fix: Canonicalise the lookup key on both allowlist reads, or canonicalise once at registration.

findings.title: Cross-repository dispatch needs the target's base commit fetched into the factory checkout by hand, or harvest dies missing-prerequisite
findings.analysis: fill's bundle-push builds its bundle in a temp scratch dir (hostBundle in src/providers/exedev/fill.ts), so the factory repo never acquires the target repo's objects. harvest then runs `git bundle verify` in process.cwd() — the factory checkout — against a bundle whose prerequisite is the target's base commit. Worked around with: git fetch <target-url> <seedSha>:refs/qds-demo/seed before harvest. Every prior live round targeted QDS-Factory itself, where the prerequisite is present by construction, so this path has evidently never been exercised.
findings.fix: Have harvest fetch the prerequisite, or run the quarantine fetch in a repo that already has it.

findings.title: hostRoot must be spelled in canonical filesystem case
findings.analysis: On a case-insensitive macOS volume, hostRoot=/Users/steve/qds-factory passes resolve() but fails loadManifest's realpath beneath-root walk, which reports the canonical /Users/steve/QDS-Factory. Caught pre-spend here; mid-round it would surface as a no-host-plan veto after teardown.

roundSetupNotes: manifestPath in the brief resolves against the FACTORY checkout, not the target repo — the manifest is host-authored by design (same INV-RV-1 posture as reverify's host plan).

Only pipeline.yaml and run-context.json are delivered into the box; the roster is NOT. The host roster (dirname(manifestPath)/roster.yaml) feeds the setup gate, while the phase's own spec.roster resolves from the target checkout. Both files are required, in two different places.
Dispatch caps runBudgetMs at a caller ceiling of 599,998 ms; the manifest was fitted to 570,000 ms (required 565,000).
The code phase's declared testCommand is what produced the single gate_results row that let hop 9 resolve; without it hop 9 would also have been broken.
